patch_description: Restore the proven XX→YY→CRZ structure from Prior Program 1 (which achieved margin 0.36) and insert a narrow CRX entanglement layer between XX and YY blocks. This follows the recommendation to enrich two-qubit phase interactions with minimal overhead by reusing the "ent_nn" parameter. The CRX gates on wire pairs [1,2], [3,4], and [5,6] add controlled rotation variety that complements the Ising gates and improves hard-sample discrimination without increasing the distinct parameter count. This should recover the better worst_group_margin performance while maintaining parameter efficiency.
